park_2015_bronchial_epithelium_asthma.section: Park et al. (2015) Nature Materials 14:1040-1048, Figs. 1-4 (Human Bronchial Epithelial Cell Air-Liquid Interface Culture & Mechanical Compression)

atia_2018_k_gamma_shape_distribution.section: Atia et al. (2018) Nature Physics 14:613-620, Fig. 1-2
atia_2018_k_gamma_shape_distribution.standardized_variable_formula: x = (q - q_min) / (mean_q - q_min),  with q_min = 3.7224 (regular hexagon bound)
atia_2018_k_gamma_shape_distribution.pdf_formula: PDF(x; k) = (k^k / Gamma(k)) * x^(k - 1) * exp(-k * x)
